names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro’s line „Sfântul Cuvios Damian, tămăduitorul de la Lavra Pecerska” for 5 octombrie.

His own name, read out of «Преп. Дамјан, Јеремија и Матеј» — the line already recorded here, which names three saints, so `pickNameForms` refuses to print it for one person and the reader was shown English instead.
The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 573, «Дамиан Печерский, пресвитер», with the office word left off.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru's 5 октября ст. ст., read 4 October 2026, prints «Прпп. Дамиана, пресвитера, целебника (1071)». The Serbian Ohrid Prologue, read the same day, gives only the century for all three of the company: «Сви из XI столећа», which contains it. The Romanian life this folder was built from gives no year, so the folder held none.

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «28 сентября (Печер.(Б))», which its own abbreviation marks as the synaxis of the saints of the Near Caves. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 5 октября ст. ст. — «Прпп. Дамиана, пресвитера, целебника (1071), Иеремии (ок. 1070) и Матфея (ок. 1085) прозорливых, Печерских.»
source.note: No rank is recorded. The one icon on the day above the plain service, «Совершается служба с полиелеем», stands before the synaxis of the hierarchs of Moscow and not before this line, and reading a polyeleos off it for the lines that follow would be an inference rather than the source's statement.

attestations.note: The Russian gives the year of death the folder had none for, 1071, and far more besides: the office, presbyter; the epithet the Romanian page renders only as a name, «целебник», the healer; and the life, written by Nestor the Chronicler.

source.text: doxologia.ro, 5 octombrie — „Sfântul Cuvios Damian, tămăduitorul de la Lavra Pecerska”

attestations.note: Not on saint.gr’s list for 5 Οκτωβρίου (checked 2026-09-17); no other day checked.

feast.note: First of the three the Ohrid Prologue names in its fourth entry for this day, which is one heading over Damian, Jeremiah and Matthew. The entry list prints two of the day’s four headings and drops this one, which opens «Преп.»

source.text: Охридски пролог, 5. октобар ст. к. — «4. Преп. Дамјан, Јеремија и Матеј. Печерски прозорљивци и чудотворци. Сви из XI столећа.»
